chung.Learning-Teaching Method: Active learning,Social Constructivism,In-class lecture,Project Based Training
chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
chung.Description: - Knowledge about data analysis concept, primary methods and processes, and analysis skills has become an essential part of an education in information system because main objectives of information systems are to support for enterprize's business. The data analysis is an very important aspect for making operation effectiveness of enterprize
chung.StudentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.

- Student is responsible to do all exercises and project given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time

- Constantly follow announcements on intranet/LMS at https://cmshn.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information regarding assignment submission and feedback on assignments and project work.

1. Rstudio

Visualize and present data findings in dashboards, presentations and commonly used visualization platforms
